mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.provider_id AS providerId, o.amount_cent AS amountCent, o.payment_method AS paymentMethod, o.invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, o.invoice_date AS invoiceDate, COALESCE(o.invoice_no, ib.invoice_no) AS invoiceNo, o.invoice_title_id AS invoiceTitleId, o.deleted_at AS deletedAt, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.updated_at AS updatedAt, o.version, COALESCE(p.name, o.provider_name_snapshot) AS providerName, COALESCE(p.website_url, o.provider_website_url_snapshot) AS providerWebsiteUrl, o.invoice_title_name_snapshot AS invoiceTitleName, o.invoice_title_type_snapshot AS invoiceTitleType, o.invoice_tax_code_snapshot AS invoiceTaxCode, (SELECT ibo.batch_id FROM invoice_batch_order ibo JOIN invoice_batch ib ON ib.id = ibo.batch_id WHERE ibo.order_id = o.id AND ib.status = 'ISSUED' ORDER BY ib.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS invoiceBatchId FROM api_order o LEFT JOIN api_provider p ON p.id = o.provider_id LEFT JOIN invoice_batch_order ibo ON ibo.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN invoice_batch ib ON ib.id = ibo.batch_id AND ib.status = 'ISSUED' WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE api_order SET order_no = #{orderNo}, provider_id = #{providerId}, provider_name_snapshot = #{providerNameSnapshot}, provider_website_url_snapshot = #{providerWebsiteUrlSnapshot}, amount_cent = #{amountCent}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE api_order SET invoice_status = #{invoiceStatus}, invoice_date = #{invoiceDate}, invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}, invoice_title_id = #{invoiceTitleId}, invoice_title_name_snapshot = #{invoiceTitleNameSnapshot}, invoice_title_type_snapshot = #{invoiceTitleTypeSnapshot}, invoice_tax_code_snapshot = #{invoiceTaxCodeSnapshot}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND invoice_status = 'UNISSUED'

UPDATE api_order SET invoice_status = 'ISSUED', invoice_date = #{invoiceDate}, invoice_no = CASE WHEN #{storeInvoiceNo} THEN #{invoiceNo} ELSE NULL END, invoice_title_id = #{invoiceTitleId}, invoice_title_name_snapshot = #{invoiceTitleName}, invoice_title_type_snapshot = #{invoiceTitleType}, invoice_tax_code_snapshot = #{invoiceTaxCode}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND invoice_status = 'UNISSUED' AND id IN
#{id}
